blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Surveillance cameras along urban roads produce large volumes of unlabeled video that could support the monitoring of public transport, but grouping the observed vehicles into meaningful categories without manual annotation remains challenging, since buses from different routes often share the same body structure and differ mainly in their color schemes. This study presents an unsupervised clustering methodology for public transport vehicles that combines morphological features extracted with a frozen DINOv2 Vision Transformer and handcrafted HSV color histograms through weighted early fusion, followed by UMAP projection and K-Means clustering. The method was evaluated on 7,972 bus images extracted from about 1,460 hours of video of an arterial road in Mexico City, with the goal of isolating the buses of the city's public bus network (RTP) without supervision. With a fusion of 65\% morphological and 35\% color features, the pipeline produced 14 clusters that separate distinct routes and vehicle types, and it increased the precision of the target cluster with respect to morphological features alone. These results show that color complements self-supervised features for route-level clustering, provided that it does not dominate the representation.
blocks.zh: 沿城市道路的监控相机产生大量无标签的视频,可以支持对公共交通的监控,但将所观测到的车辆分为有意义的类别而不进行人工注释仍然是有挑战性的,因为来自不同路线的公交车通常具有相同的车体结构,并且主要在它们的配色方案上有所不同. 本研究为公交车辆提出了一种无监督的集群方法,将所提取的形态特征与被冷冻的DINOv2视觉变形器和手动的HSV色直方图通过加权早期聚变,再由UMAP投影和K-Means集群. 从墨西哥城一条动脉道约1,460小时的视频中提取出7,972辆公交车的图像对这种方法进行了评价,目标是在没有监督的情况下隔离该市公共公交网络(RTP)的公交车. 管道以65-Q的形态特征和35-Q的颜色特征相融合,产生了14个将不同的路线和车辆类型相分离的集群,它提高了目标集群仅就形态特征而言的精度. 这些结果显示,色彩是对路由级集群自我监督的特征的补充,前提是它不主导代表.

blocks.en: I Introduction
blocks.zh: 一. 导言

blocks.en: Public transport is the backbone of mobility in large cities, and its efficient management requires continuous information about which vehicles operate on each corridor, how often they pass, and whether they follow their assigned routes. Intelligent Transportation Systems (ITS) increasingly obtain this information from the surveillance cameras already installed along urban roads. These cameras generate thousands of hours of video, far more than can be inspected or annotated manually, so methods that extract useful information from such footage without human supervision are of great practical value.
blocks.zh: 公共交通是大城市流动的支柱,其高效管理需要不断了解每条走廊上运行的车辆,通过次数,以及是否遵循指定路线. 智能交通系统(ITS)越来越多地从沿城市道路安装的监视摄像头获取这些信息. 这些摄像头产生几千小时的视频,远远超出可以手动检查或附加说明的范围,因此在没有人类监督的情况下从这些镜头中提取有用信息的方法具有极大的实用价值.

blocks.en: In this work, we address the problem of grouping public transport vehicles captured by a fixed surveillance camera into semantically meaningful categories, such as transit routes and operators, without using labeled data. The problem is challenging for two complementary reasons. First, buses operating on different routes often share the same body structure and differ mainly in their paint schemes. Second, vehicles of different types, such as full-size buses, microbuses (small buses), and vans, may share similar colors while differing substantially in shape. A useful representation must therefore capture both morphology and color.
blocks.zh: 在这项工作中,我们处理将固定监视摄像头捕获的公共交通车辆编组成具有广泛意义的类别,如过境路线和运营商,而不使用标签数据的问题。 由于两个相辅相成的原因,这个问题具有挑战性。 首先,在不同路线上运行的客车往往具有相同的车体结构,主要在涂装方案上有所不同. 第二,不同种类的车辆,如全尺寸巴士,微客车(小客车)和面包车,可能具有相似的颜色,但形状差别很大. 因此,有用的表述必须既能捕捉形态,又能捕捉颜色。

blocks.en: Most vision-based vehicle classification systems are supervised and rely on large, site-specific annotated datasets with fixed taxonomies in which “bus” is a single class [ 1 , 2 , 3 ] . Self-supervised learning has reduced the need for labels during representation learning [ 4 ] , but in the vehicle domain it has mainly been used as pre-training for a supervised classifier [ 5 ] . Unsupervised clustering, on the other hand, has been applied mainly to vehicle re-identification, which groups images of the same physical vehicle rather than different vehicles that share a category [ 6 ] . Self-supervised Vision Transformers such as DINOv2 [ 7 ] now provide general-purpose descriptors that capture image structure well without fine-tuning. However, their features may under-represent pure chromatic information, which is crucial for distinguishing transit routes.
blocks.zh: 大多数基于视觉的车辆分类系统都受到监督,并依赖大型的、针对具体地点的附加说明的数据集,其中“公共汽车”为单一类别[1、2、3]。 自我监督的学习减少了在代表学习过程中对标签的需求[4],但在车辆领域,它主要用作被监督的分类器的前期训练[5]. 另一方面,不受监督的集群主要用于车辆的重新识别,即将同一物理车辆的图像分组,而不是将共享一个类别[6]的不同车辆分组. 自我监督 DINOv2[7]等Visual Transformers目前提供通用描述器,能很好地捕捉图像结构而无需微调. 然而,它们的特征可能不足以代表纯色信息,而这种信息对于区分过境路线至关重要。

blocks.en: To address this problem, we propose a hybrid unsupervised clustering pipeline for public transport vehicles. Buses are first detected and tracked in the video, and a single crop is stored per vehicle. Each crop is then described by two complementary descriptors: a morphological descriptor given by the class token of a frozen DINOv2 model, and a color descriptor given by hue and saturation histograms computed in the HSV color space. Both descriptors are normalized and combined through weighted early fusion, and the fused vectors are projected with UMAP and grouped with K-Means, as illustrated in Fig. 1 . We apply the pipeline to images of buses operating on one of the main arterial roads of Mexico City, and evaluate whether it can isolate the buses of the Red de Transporte de Pasajeros (RTP), the city’s public bus network, as a coherent cluster.
blocks.zh: 为了解决这一问题,我们提议为公共交通车辆建造一个混合的、不受监督的集束管道。 公交车首先在视频中检测和跟踪,每辆车存储一个单一的作物. 每种作物然后用两个补充描述符来描述:一个是由冷冻的DINOv2模型的类代号给出的形态描述符,另一个是由HSV颜色空间中计算出的色素和饱和度直方图给出的颜色描述符。 如图1所示,两种描述符都通过加权早期聚变实现正常化和结合,并预测引信矢量与UMAP并按K-Means组合。 我们把管道应用于在墨西哥城一条干线公路上运行的公交车的图像,并评估它是否能够将该市的公共公交网络Red de Transporte de Pasajeros(RTP)的公交车隔离成一个连贯的集群。

blocks.en: Fig. 1: Overview of the proposed unsupervised clustering pipeline. Buses are detected and tracked in surveillance video, each crop is described by frozen DINOv2 morphological features and HSV color histograms, both descriptors are combined through weighted early fusion, and the fused vectors are projected with UMAP and grouped with K-Means. Bus illustrations were generated with AI.
blocks.zh: 费格。 1: 拟议的无监督集群管线概述. 监视视频中检测和跟踪公共汽车,每条作物都通过冷冻的DINOv2形态特征和HSV色直方图来描述,两种描述符通过加权早期聚变进行组合,并用UMAP和K-Means组合投射引信矢量. 公共汽车插图是与AI一起生成的.

blocks.en: The main contributions of this paper are as follows: • An unsupervised pipeline that fuses frozen self-supervised morphological features with handcrafted color histograms to cluster public transport vehicles captured by a surveillance camera, without requiring labels at any stage of feature extraction or clustering. • A dataset of 7,972 bus images extracted from about 1,460 hours of video of a Mexico City arterial road, manually annotated for evaluation and publicly available at https://www.kaggle.com/datasets/irvingvasquez/public-bus-images . • An ablation study on the fusion weight showing that a moderate color contribution increases the precision of the target cluster with respect to morphological features alone, whereas an excessive color weight leads to over-segmentation or to the collapse of the clustering space.
blocks.zh: 本文件的主要贡献如下: 无监督的管道,将冷冻的自控形态特征与手工制作的彩色直方图连接到被监视摄像头捕获的集束公共交通车辆上,而无需在特征提取或集束的任何阶段设置标签. • 支助 从墨西哥城一条动脉路大约1 460小时的视频中提取的7 972个公交车图像数据集,人工附加说明供评估,并公布在https://www.kaggle.com/datasets/irvingvasquez/public-bus-images上。 对聚变重量的偏差研究表明,中度的颜色贡献会提高目标集群相对于形态特征的精度,而过量的色彩重量则会导致聚变空间的过度分化或崩溃.

blocks.en: An unsupervised pipeline that fuses frozen self-supervised morphological features with handcrafted color histograms to cluster public transport vehicles captured by a surveillance camera, without requiring labels at any stage of feature extraction or clustering.
blocks.zh: 无监督的管道,将冷冻的自控形态特征与手工制作的彩色直方图连接到被监视摄像头捕获的集束公共交通车辆上,而无需在特征提取或集束的任何阶段设置标签.

blocks.en: A dataset of 7,972 bus images extracted from about 1,460 hours of video of a Mexico City arterial road, manually annotated for evaluation and publicly available at https://www.kaggle.com/datasets/irvingvasquez/public-bus-images .
blocks.zh: 从墨西哥城一条动脉路大约1 460小时的视频中提取的7 972个公交车图像数据集,人工附加说明以供评估,并在https://www.kaggle.com/datasets/irvingvasquez/public-bus-images上公布。

blocks.en: An ablation study on the fusion weight showing that a moderate color contribution increases the precision of the target cluster with respect to morphological features alone, whereas an excessive color weight leads to over-segmentation or to the collapse of the clustering space.
blocks.zh: 对聚变重量的偏差研究表明,中度的颜色贡献会提高目标集群相对于形态特征的精度,而过量的色彩重量则会导致聚变空间的过度分化或崩溃.

blocks.en: The remainder of this paper is organized as follows. Section II reviews related work on vehicle classification, self-supervised learning, and clustering. Section III describes the dataset and the proposed clustering pipeline. Section IV presents the quantitative and qualitative results. Finally, Section V concludes the paper and outlines future work.
blocks.zh: 本文件的其余部分编排如下。 第二节审查了车辆分类、自我监督学习和集群的相关工作。 第三节介绍数据集和拟议的集群管道。 第四节介绍定量和定性结果。 最后,该科 五. 结束文件并概述今后的工作。

blocks.en: II Related Work
blocks.zh: 二. 相关工作

blocks.en: Vision-based vehicle classification has evolved from hand-crafted descriptors, such as Haar-like features and histograms of oriented gradients (HOG), combined with shallow classifiers such as support vector machines and AdaBoost, to convolutional neural networks trained end-to-end [ 1 ] . Supervised deep models now reach high accuracy. Butt et al. [ 2 ] fine-tuned several CNNs on 10,000 images of six vehicle types captured under adverse illumination and reported 99.68% accuracy, and Neupane et al. [ 3 ] fine-tuned YOLO detectors on nearly 30,000 manually annotated samples of seven classes, including buses. The latter study also shows the cost of domain shift: accuracy roughly doubled (from at most 30% to 71%) only after fine-tuning on data from the target cameras. These systems therefore depend on large, site-specific annotated datasets and on fixed taxonomies in which “bus” is a single class, so they cannot distinguish buses of different routes or operators.
blocks.zh: 基于视觉的车辆分类从手动的描述器,如Haar类似特征和定向梯度的直方图(HOG),加上辅助矢量机和AdaBoost等浅层分类器,演化为训练有素的端对端神经网络[1]. 监督的深层模型现在达到了很高的精确度. Butt等人 (英语). [2] 微调了几张CNN在负面照明下捕获的1万张6种车辆类型的图像,并报告了99.68%的准确度,Neupane等人. [3]对包括公交车在内的7个班级的近30,000个手动标注样本的YOLO探测器进行了微调. 后一项研究还显示域位转移的成本:精确度大约翻了一番(从最多30%增加到71%),只有在对目标摄像头的数据进行微调后才能进行. 因此,这些系统依赖于大型的、针对具体地点的附加说明的数据集和“巴士”为单一类别的固定分类,因此无法区分不同路线或运营商的巴士。

blocks.en: Self-supervised learning (SSL) reduces this dependence by learning representations from unlabeled images [ 4 ] . In the vehicle domain, Ma and Yang [ 5 ] showed that Vision Transformer features learned with DINO and data2vec, combined with wheel-position cues, reach 97.2% top-1 accuracy on the 13 axle-based classes of the U.S. Federal Highway Administration. However, SSL is used there only as pre-training for a supervised classifier, and buses again form a single class.
blocks.zh: 自我监督的学习(SSL)通过从无标签的图像中学习表现来减少这种依赖性[4]. 在车辆领域,马和杨[5]显示,用DINO和data2vec学习的Visual Transformer特性,加上轮位提示,在美国联邦高速公路管理局的13个轴基等级上达到97.2%的最高-1精度. 然而,SSL只在那里用作受监督分类员的预训,巴士再次组成一个单级.

blocks.en: Deep clustering removes labels altogether by coupling a representation-learning module with a clustering module [ 8 ] . Zhou et al. [ 8 ] group these methods into multistage, generative, iterative, and simultaneous approaches; our pipeline belongs to the multistage family, in which features are extracted first and clustered afterwards. Hou et al. [ 9 ] note that, before deep learning, image clustering relied on hand-crafted descriptors such as color histograms, and identify robustness to noise and real-world applicability as open challenges for deep image clustering. In the vehicle domain, clustering has mainly been used for unsupervised re-identification (Re-ID). Qiu et al. [ 6 ] , for instance, generate pseudo-identity labels with a camera-aware DBSCAN scheme and refine them with a focal contrastive loss, outperforming previous unsupervised methods on VeRi-776 and VERI-Wild. Re-ID, however, groups images of the same physical vehicle , whereas our goal is to group different vehicles that share a semantic category.
blocks.zh: 深度集群通过将表达-学习模块与集群模块[8]组合起来,完全去除标签. 周 et等编. [8] 将这些方法分为多阶段、基因、迭代和同步方法;我们的管道属于多阶段家族,其中首先提取特征,然后分组。 许等. [9]注意,在深度学习之前,图像集成依赖于颜色直方图等手工制作的描述符,并将噪音的强性和现实世界的适用性确定为深度图像集成的开放挑战. 在车辆领域,集群主要用于无监督的重新识别(Re-ID). 邱等编. [6] 例如,用相机感知DBSCAN计划生成伪识别标签,并以焦距对比损失加以精炼,在VeRi-776和VERI-Wild上表现优于以前未经监督的方法. 然而,重新识别, 组合同一物理飞行器的图像, 而我们的目标是组合 不同的飞行器,

blocks.en: In summary, existing work either classifies vehicles into coarse, predefined types [ 2 , 3 , 5 ] or matches individual vehicles across cameras [ 6 ] . To our knowledge, the unsupervised, category-level partitioning of the bus class, in which vehicles of different routes share a body structure and differ mainly in livery, has not been addressed. Moreover, none of the reviewed works combines self-supervised deep features with explicit color descriptors, even though color is a decisive cue for route identity. This work addresses both gaps.
blocks.zh: 简言之,现有工作要么将车辆分为粗体,预先界定的型号[2,3,5],要么与单个车辆搭配过相机[6]. 据我们所知,公交车班次的无监督,分类等级划分,不同路线的车辆共用车体结构,主要在生活上有所不同,目前尚未解决. 此外,被审阅的作品中没有任何一部将自我监督的深层特征与明确的色彩描述词结合起来,尽管色彩是路由身份的决定性提示. 这项工作弥补了这两个差距。

blocks.en: III Materials and Methods
blocks.zh: 三. 材料和方法

blocks.en: III-A Dataset
blocks.zh: 数据集

blocks.en: The dataset was constructed from approximately 1,460 hours of continuous video recorded during June and July 2026. Recordings were acquired with a single fixed camera mounted at a height of 5 m and positioned 30 m from Circuito Interior, one of the main arterial roads of Mexico City. The camera was oriented toward the roadway, providing a consistent view of passing traffic, including public transport buses operating on multiple routes.
blocks.zh: 数据集是根据2026年6月和7月期间录制的约1 460小时连续视频构建的. 录音用安装在5米高的单台固定照相机购买,定位30米,来自墨西哥城的主要动脉道路之一Circulo Internal。 摄影机面向公路,对过往交通,包括在多条路线上运行的公共交通客车,提供了一致的视野.

blocks.en: III-A 1 Bus Detection
blocks.zh: III-A 1 客车检测

blocks.en: Given the large volume of recorded video, manual annotation of the full videos was impractical. The videos were therefore preprocessed using the YOLO26 object detector [ 10 ] combined with a multi-object tracker. Only detections belonging to the bus class were retained, and a single image was stored for each tracked vehicle to avoid redundant samples of the same bus. To prevent truncation of the vehicle body, each bounding box was expanded by 10% before cropping. This process yielded a total of 7,972 cropped images of public transport vehicles. Because the detector does not distinguish between subtypes, this set includes buses, microbuses, and vans, all of which were classified as bus by YOLO26. Fig. 2 shows examples of the resulting images.
blocks.zh: 鉴于录制的视频量很大,手工说明完整视频是不切实际的。 因此,这些视频是使用YOLO26对象探测器[10]与多对象跟踪器结合进行预处理的. 只保留了属于巴士类的探测器,并且为每辆履带式车辆存储了单一的图像,以避免同一巴士的冗余样本. 为防止车辆车体的截断,每个捆绑箱在裁剪前均扩大10%. 这一过程共产生了7 972幅被切割的公共交通车辆图像。 由于探测器没有区分子型号,本集包括巴士,微客车,和货车,这些车都被YOLO26归类为总线. 图2显示了由此产生的图像的例子。

blocks.en: Fig. 2: Example images from the dataset, cropped from the surveillance video after bus detection and tracking. Because YOLO26 does not distinguish between bus subtypes, the dataset includes full-size buses, microbuses, and vans.
blocks.zh: 费格。 2:数据集的示例图像,在公交车检测和跟踪后从监控视频中裁剪. 由于YOLO26没有区分总线子型号,数据集包括全尺寸总线车,微总线车和面包车.

blocks.en: III-A 2 Ground-Truth Annotation
blocks.zh: III-A 2 地面真理注释

blocks.en: Although the proposed clustering approach is fully unsupervised, ground-truth labels were required to evaluate its performance. To this end, all 7,972 images were manually annotated. These labels were used exclusively for evaluation and were not involved at any stage of feature extraction or clustering. Two hierarchical binary labels were assigned to each image: is bus and is RTP bus , where the latter is a subset of the former. The is bus label indicates whether the crop contains a full-size bus and was introduced to assess the precision of the YOLO26-based preprocessing stage, given that smaller vehicles such as microbuses and vans were also detected under the bus class. The is RTP bus label identifies vehicles belonging to the Red de Transporte de Pasajeros (RTP), Mexico City’s public bus network, which constitute the target class of this study.
blocks.zh: 虽然拟议的分组办法完全不受监督,但需要用地面真实标签来评价其业绩。 为此,所有7 972幅图像都是手动注释的. 这些标签只用于评价,没有参与任何特征提取或集群阶段。 每个图像被分配了两个层次二进制标签:是总线,是RTP总线,后者是前者的子集. 其为总线标签,表示作物是否包含全尺寸总线,并被引入来评估基于YOLO26的预处理阶段的精度,因为微客车和货车等较小的车辆也在总线类别下被检测到. RTP公交车的标签是"Red de Transporte de Pasajeros"(RTP),是墨西哥城的公共公交车网络,构成本研究的目标类别.

blocks.en: III-B Bus Clustering
blocks.zh: 三-B型客车编组

blocks.en: The objective of this stage is to group the detected vehicles into clusters that correspond to semantically meaningful categories, such as bus routes and vehicle types, without relying on labeled data. The proposed pipeline consists of three steps: (i) extraction of complementary morphological and color descriptors from each image, (ii) early fusion of both descriptors into a single weighted feature vector, and (iii) unsupervised clustering of the fused representations. The following subsections describe each step in detail.
blocks.zh: 这一阶段的目标是将检测到的车辆编组成群,与公交线路和车辆类型等具有高度意义的类别相对应,而不依赖于标注的数据. 拟议的管道包括三个步骤:(一) 从每个图像中提取互补的形态和颜色描述符,(二) 将两个描述符及早融合成一个单一的加权特征矢量,(三) 将引信的表示符不加监督地分组。 以下各小节详细描述了每个步骤.

blocks.en: III-B 1 Feature Extraction
blocks.zh: III-B 1 提取特性

blocks.en: Buses operating on different routes often share similar body structures but differ in their paint schemes, whereas vehicles of different types (e.g., full-size buses, microbuses, and vans) may exhibit similar colors while differing substantially in shape. To capture both sources of variation, two complementary types of features were extracted from each image: deep morphological features and handcrafted color features.
blocks.zh: 在不同路线上运行的客车通常具有相似的车体结构,但其涂料方案不同,而不同型号的车辆(如全尺寸的客车、微型客车和面包车)则可能呈现相似的颜色,而形状则大不相同。 为了捕捉两种变异源,从每个图像中提取了两种互补的特征:深层形态特征和手工制作的颜色特征.

blocks.en: Morphological features: These features were extracted using DINOv2 [ 7 ] , a family of Vision Transformer (ViT) [ 11 ] models trained through self-supervised learning. Unlike text-guided approaches such as CLIP [ 12 ] , which depend on paired image and caption data, DINOv2 learns visual representations from images alone. Its training objective combines an image-level self-distillation loss, computed on the class token between a student and a teacher network observing different crops of the same image, with a patch-level masked image modeling loss inherited from iBOT [ 13 ] .
blocks.zh: 口腔特征: 这些特征是使用DINOv2[7]提取的,这是一个通过自我监督的学习来训练的视觉变形器家族(ViT)[11]模型. 与CLIP[12]等以配对图像和字幕数据为依托的文本引导方法不同,DINOv2仅从图像中学习视觉表现. 其培训目标结合了图像层次的自我消化损失,在学生和教师网络之间的课堂符号上计算,观测同一图像的不同作物,还有从iBOT[13]中继承下来的补丁层次的遮盖图像模型损失.

blocks.en: A key property of DINOv2 is that its features perform well as frozen, general-purpose descriptors, without requiring task-specific fine-tuning. Its authors report strong results with simple linear classifiers and nearest-neighbor retrieval across a wide range of benchmarks, including fine-grained vehicle recognition on Stanford Cars [ 7 ] . These properties make DINOv2 well suited to an unsupervised setting such as ours, in which no labeled data are available for fine-tuning and the cluster structure depends directly on the geometry of the embedding space.
blocks.zh: DINOv2的关键财产是其特性性能良好,以及具有一般用途的冷冻描述器,而不需要对特定任务进行微调. 其作者报告有强效结果,有简单的线性分类器和最近的近邻检索,跨越广泛的基准,包括在斯坦福汽车[7]上的细纹车辆识别. 这些属性使得DINOv2非常适合像我们这样的不受监督的设置,在这种设置中,没有标签数据可供微调,集群结构直接取决于嵌入空间的几何.

blocks.en: In this work, we employed the publicly available facebook/dinov2-small checkpoint, which corresponds to the ViT-S/14 variant of DINOv2 distilled from the ViT-g/14 teacher. Its main architectural characteristics are summarized in Table I . The model was used exclusively as a frozen feature extractor: it was loaded in evaluation mode, gradient computation was disabled, and no fine-tuning or retraining was performed. For each image I i I_{i} , the [CLS] token of the final hidden layer was taken as a global descriptor of the vehicle’s structure, yielding a morphological feature vector 𝐟 i morph ∈ ℝ 384 . \mathbf{f}^{\text{morph}}_{i}\in\mathbb{R}^{384}. (1)

blocks.en: Color features: To capture the route-specific paint schemes that distinguish otherwise structurally similar buses, color histograms were computed in the HSV color space. HSV was preferred over RGB because it separates chromatic information from intensity, making the descriptor less sensitive to the illumination changes that occur throughout the day in outdoor recordings. Accordingly, only the Hue and Saturation channels were used, and the Value channel was discarded.
blocks.zh: 颜色特性 : 为了捕捉在结构上相似的客车的专用路线涂料方案,在HSV彩色空间中计算了彩色直方图。 HSV比RGB更受青睐,因为它将色谱信息与强度区分开来,使得描述器对室外录音中全天发生的照明变化不太敏感. 因此,只使用惠和饱和频道,而放弃了价值频道。

blocks.en: Because the expanded bounding boxes include surrounding background such as asphalt, sky, and other vehicles, a central crop covering 50% of the image area was applied before computing the histograms, so that the descriptor predominantly reflects the vehicle body. One-dimensional histograms with 32 bins were then computed for the Hue and Saturation channels and concatenated, yielding a color feature vector 𝐟 i color = [ 𝐡 i H ∥ 𝐡 i S ] ∈ ℝ 64 , \mathbf{f}^{\text{color}}_{i}=\left[\,\mathbf{h}^{H}_{i}\,\|\,\mathbf{h}^{S}_{i}\,\right]\in\mathbb{R}^{64}, (2) where 𝐡 i H \mathbf{h}^{H}_{i} and 𝐡 i S \mathbf{h}^{S}_{i} denote the Hue and Saturation histograms of image I i I_{i} , and ∥ \| denotes concatenation.

blocks.zh: III-B 2 早期特性融合

blocks.en: The morphological and color descriptors differ in both dimensionality (384 versus 64) and numerical scale. To make them comparable, each vector was first L2-normalized independently: 𝐟 ^ i morph = 𝐟 i morph ∥ 𝐟 i morph ∥ 2 , 𝐟 ^ i color = 𝐟 i color ∥ 𝐟 i color ∥ 2 . \hat{\mathbf{f}}^{\text{morph}}_{i}=\frac{\mathbf{f}^{\text{morph}}_{i}}{\lVert\mathbf{f}^{\text{morph}}_{i}\rVert_{2}},\qquad\hat{\mathbf{f}}^{\text{color}}_{i}=\frac{\mathbf{f}^{\text{color}}_{i}}{\lVert\mathbf{f}^{\text{color}}_{i}\rVert_{2}}. (3) This normalization ensures that both descriptors lie on the unit hypersphere, so that their relative influence is governed by the fusion weights rather than by their original dimensionality.

blocks.en: III-B 3 Clustering and Evaluation
blocks.zh: 三. B 3 分组和评价

blocks.en: Distance-based clustering algorithms such as K-Means tend to degrade in high-dimensional spaces, where pairwise distances become less discriminative. Therefore, the fused vectors were first projected onto a lower-dimensional manifold using Uniform Manifold Approximation and Projection (UMAP) [ 14 ] , a nonlinear dimensionality reduction technique that preserves the local neighborhood structure of the data while retaining much of its global organization.
blocks.zh: 基于距离的集群算法如K-Means往往在高维空间中降解,其中双向距离变得不那么具有区分性. 因此,引信矢量首先被投射到一个低维的多维面上,使用University Manifold approphymation and Projection(UMAP)[14],这是一种非线性维度降低技术,它保留了数据的局部邻域结构,同时保留了其大部分全球组织。

blocks.en: K-Means clustering [ 15 ] was subsequently applied to the reduced representations for each number of clusters K ∈ { 2 , … , 30 } K\in\{2,\ldots,30\} . The optimal value of K K was selected by jointly considering two internal validation criteria. The Elbow Method examines the within-cluster sum of squares as a function of K K and identifies the point beyond which additional clusters yield diminishing reductions. The Silhouette Score [ 16 ] measures, for each sample, how similar it is to its own cluster relative to the nearest neighboring cluster, ranging from − 1 -1 to 1 1 , where higher values indicate compact and well-separated clusters. This procedure was repeated independently for each value of α \alpha .
blocks.zh: K- means集群 [15] 之后被应用于每组K {} {2,..., 30} K\in} 2,\ ldots, 30} 的表示减少. 通过联合考虑两个内部验证标准,选定了K K的最佳值. Elbow方法作为KK的一项功能,审查方块内组群的总和,并找出额外组群减少的点。 Silhouette分数[16]对每个样本的测量,相对于最近的邻星群来说,它与自己的星群有多相似,从− 1 - 1 到-1 1 不等,其中较高的值表示紧凑和分隔良好的星群. α-α的每个值都是独立重复的。

blocks.en: IV Results
blocks.zh: 四. 结果

blocks.en: The objective of the proposed method is to cluster the bus images and to determine whether the buses operated by RTP can be isolated into a coherent group without supervision. Accordingly, this section evaluates the proposed unsupervised early fusion approach against a baseline that clusters the images using morphological features alone. In addition, an ablation study was conducted to analyze the effect of the fusion weight α \alpha on clustering performance, considering three configurations: α = 0.65 \alpha=0.65 , α = 0.50 \alpha=0.50 , and α = 0.35 \alpha=0.35 . The resulting clusters were assessed both quantitatively, by comparing them against the manually annotated target class, and qualitatively, through visual inspection of their contents.
blocks.zh: 拟议方法的目标是将总线图像分组,并确定RTP运营的大线能否在没有监督的情况下被隔离成一个连贯的群. 因此,本节根据一个仅利用形态特征将图像分组的基线,评价拟议的不受监督的早期聚变方法。 此外,还进行了一项减速研究,分析聚变重量α-α对聚变性能的影响,考虑了三种构型:α=0.65 α=0.65,α=0.50 α=0.50,α=0.35 α=0.35 . 通过对分组进行定量评估,将其与人工附加说明的目标类别进行比较,并通过目视检查其内容,对分组进行定性评估。

blocks.en: IV-A Implementation Details
blocks.zh: 四-A 执行详情

blocks.en: All components were implemented in Python and executed on a workstation equipped with an Intel Core i7 processor and an NVIDIA GTX 1080 GPU. To facilitate experimentation, feature extraction and clustering were implemented as independent stages. Morphological features were extracted with PyTorch [ 17 ] and Hugging Face Transformers [ 18 ] using the pretrained facebook/dinov2-small checkpoint. Images were loaded with PIL, processed by the library’s default image processor in batches of 64, and the resulting class tokens were stored as NumPy arrays. Color histograms were computed with OpenCV [ 19 ] on the central crop of each image. Both descriptors were L2-normalized with scikit-learn [ 20 ] , the fused matrix was embedded with the umap-learn library [ 14 ] , and K-Means clustering and Silhouette analysis were performed with scikit-learn.
blocks.zh: 所有组件均在Python执行,并在一个配备了Intel Core i7处理器和NVIDIA GTX 1080 GPU的工作站上执行. 为便利实验,将地物提取和集群作为独立阶段进行。 与PyTorch [17] 和Hugging Face Transformers [18] 使用预训的facebook/dinov2-小检查点提取了形态特征. 图像被加载为PIL,由库的默认图像处理器分批处理64个,产生的类符号被存储为NumPy数组. 彩色直方图用 OpenCV [19] 计算在每个图像的中心裁剪上。 两种描述符均与scikit-learn [20] 进行L2规范化,被熔化的矩阵与 umap-learn 库 [14] 嵌入,K-Means集群和Silhouette分析则与scikit-learn一起进行.

blocks.en: IV-B Evaluation Protocol
blocks.zh: 四-B 评价议定书

The entropy equals zero when all RTP buses are grouped into a single cluster and increases as they become dispersed across multiple clusters. In addition, accuracy, precision, recall, and F1-score were computed by treating the cluster containing the largest number of RTP buses as the predicted RTP class and comparing its members against the manually annotated labels.

blocks.en: IV-C Quantitative Analysis
blocks.zh: 四-C 定量分析

blocks.en: The early fusion configuration with α = 0.65 \alpha=0.65 achieved the best overall performance, with the highest accuracy (0.9521), precision (0.9507), and F1-score (0.7516) among all methods. Compared with the morphological baseline, incorporating color information increased precision by 18 percentage points (from 0.7703 to 0.9507) and the F1-score by 7.6 points (from 0.6759 to 0.7516), while also reducing the entropy from 1.175 to 1.059 bits. In contrast, recall improved only marginally (from 0.6022 to 0.6215). This indicates that the main contribution of the color descriptor is to increase cluster purity: the dominant RTP cluster obtained through fusion contains far fewer non-RTP vehicles, most likely buses from other routes that share a similar body structure but differ in livery, which morphological features alone cannot reliably distinguish.
blocks.zh: α=0.65\alpha=0.65的早期核聚变配置实现了最佳的整体性能,在所有方法中,其精度最高(0.9521),精度最高(0.9507),F1-分数(0.7516). 与形态学基线相比,纳入颜色信息精度提高了18个百分点(从0.7703提高到0.9507),F1-分数提高了7.6个百分点(从0.6759下降到0.7516),同时将 en从1.175位减少到1.059位. 与此相反,召回情况略有改善(从0.6022增至0.6215)。 这表明色彩描述符的主要贡献在于提高集群纯度:通过聚变获得的主导RTP集群包含的非RTP载体要少得多,最有可能是来自其他车道的客车,这些车体结构类似但活性不同,单是形态特征无法可靠区分.

blocks.en: Nevertheless, the recall of approximately 0.62 obtained by both the baseline and the best fusion configuration shows that a substantial fraction of RTP buses (about 38%) is assigned to clusters other than the dominant one. This is consistent with the nonzero entropy values and suggests that the RTP class is not homogeneous in the feature space, possibly due to variations in viewpoint, illumination, partial occlusions, or differences among RTP vehicle models and paint schemes.
blocks.zh: 然而,基线和最佳聚变配置获得的约0.62次召回表明,相当一部分RTP客车(约38%)被分配到主力客车以外的集群. 这与非零 en值一致,并表明RTP类在特征空间中并不均匀,可能是由于视线,照明,部分隔离,或RTP车型和涂料方案的差异.

blocks.en: Performance did not vary monotonically with the color weight. With α = 0.50 \alpha=0.50 , precision remained high (0.8988), but recall dropped to 0.4774 and the entropy reached its highest value (1.680 bits), indicating that the RTP buses were fragmented across a larger number of clusters ( K = 20 K=20 ). As a result, the F1-score of this configuration (0.6236) fell below that of the morphological baseline. It should be noted that, because both descriptors are unit-normalized and the weights act quadratically on the squared Euclidean distance, α = 0.50 \alpha=0.50 assigns equal influence to both descriptors, whereas α = 0.35 \alpha=0.35 gives color roughly 3.4 times the influence of morphology.
blocks.zh: 性能与颜色重量没有单调差异。 由于α = 0.50\alpha = 0.50,精度仍然很高(0.8988),但召回率下降至0.4774, en值达到最高值(1.680比特),表明RTP客车在更大数量的集群(K = 20K = 20)间支离破碎. 因此,这种配置的F1-分数(0.6236)低于形态基线. 需要注意的是,由于两种描述符都是单位正常的,且重量在平方的欧几里底距离上四倍作用,α = 0.50\alpha = 0.50对两种描述符都具有同等的影响,而α = 0.35\alpha = 0.35对颜色的影响约为形态学的3.4倍.

blocks.en: The configuration with α = 0.35 \alpha=0.35 illustrates the failure mode of an excessive color weight. Although it yielded the lowest entropy (0.012 bits) and a near-perfect recall (0.9989), these values do not reflect a successful separation. With only three clusters, virtually all RTP buses fall into a single cluster, but this cluster also contains a large number of non-RTP vehicles, as reflected by a precision of only 0.2606 and the lowest accuracy and F1-score of all configurations (0.6692 and 0.4133, respectively). In other words, the low entropy is a consequence of the collapse of the clustering space rather than of an accurate grouping of the target class. This case highlights that entropy and recall must be interpreted jointly with precision, since each of them can be trivially optimized by a degenerate solution.
blocks.zh: α=0.35\alpha=0.35的配置说明了过量的色彩重量的失败模式. 虽然它产生了最低的 en(0.012比特)和近乎完美的召回(0.9989),但这些值并不反映成功的分离. 由于只有3个编组,几乎所有RTP客车都属于一个编组,但这个编组也包含大量非RTP车辆,这体现在精确度只有0.2606,精确度最低和所有配置的F1分数(分别为0.6692和0.4133). 换句话说,低 en是集群空间崩溃的结果,而不是目标类的精确分组. 这个案例强调,必须精确地共同解释 en和召回,因为每种现象都可以被一种堕落的解决方案轻而易举地优化。

blocks.en: Accuracy should also be interpreted with caution. Because RTP buses represent a minority of the dataset, a trivial classifier that labels every image as non-RTP would already achieve a high accuracy. The F1-score and precision are therefore more informative indicators of the quality of the RTP cluster.
blocks.zh: 准确性的解释也应谨慎。 由于RTP总线代表了数据集的少数部分,将每个图像标注为非RTP的细微分类器就已经实现了高精度. 因此,F1分数和精确度更能说明RTP组的质量。

blocks.en: Overall, these results show that, with an appropriate fusion weight, the proposed methodology groups the majority of the target class into a single, highly pure cluster. This supports our hypothesis and suggests that the approach can facilitate the detection of public transport vehicles without the need for large annotated datasets.
blocks.zh: 总的来说,这些结果表明,在适当的聚变权重下,拟议方法将大多数目标类归入一个单一的,高度纯度的集群. 这支持我们的假设,并表明这种方法可以便利对公共交通车辆的检测,而不需要大型附加说明的数据集.

blocks.en: IV-D Qualitative Analysis
blocks.zh: 四-D 定性分析

blocks.en: Fig. 3: Randomly selected images from the dominant RTP cluster obtained with early fusion ( α = 0.65 \alpha=0.65 ).
blocks.zh: 图3:通过早期聚变获得的主要RTP集群随机选取的图像(α=0.65\α=0.65).

blocks.en: Visual inspection of the resulting clusters supports the quantitative findings. With α = 0.65 \alpha=0.65 , the Silhouette analysis indicated an optimal value of K = 14 K=14 , and the clusters were highly homogeneous: vehicles with distinct shapes were correctly separated, while buses belonging to the same transit route remained chromatically consistent within their clusters. Fig. 3 shows twelve randomly selected members of the dominant RTP cluster.
blocks.zh: 对由此产生的集群进行目视检查有助于量化结论。 α=0.65\alpha=0.65),Silhouette分析显示K=14K=14的最佳值,集群高度一致:形状鲜明的车辆正确分离,而属于同一中转路线的客车在其集群内保持色调一致. 图3显示主要RTP集群中随机选定的十二个成员。

blocks.en: Increasing the color weight to α = 0.50 \alpha=0.50 shifted the optimal number of clusters to K = 20 K=20 . In this configuration, cohesive groups were split into fragmented sub-clusters that appeared to be driven primarily by minor variations in lighting or saturation rather than by differences in vehicle structure.
blocks.zh: 增加色重为α = 0.50\alpha = 0.50 将最佳组数改为 K = 20 K = 20. 在这种配置中,凝聚的团体被分成支离破碎的分组,这些分组的驱动力似乎主要是照明或饱和程度的细微变化,而不是车辆结构的差异。

blocks.en: When color dominated the fusion ( α = 0.35 \alpha=0.35 ), the clustering collapsed to K = 3 K=3 . The model became largely insensitive to structural differences, grouping morphologically distinct vehicles, such as vans and full-size buses, into the same cluster simply because they shared dominant colors.
blocks.zh: 当颜色主导聚变(α=0.35\alpha=0.35)时,聚变崩溃为K=3K=3. 该模型在很大程度上对结构差异不敏感,仅仅因为车厢和全尺寸客车具有主导色彩,就将形态上截然不同的车辆组合成同一组.

blocks.en: Overall, these results confirm that color is a highly discriminative cue for identifying public transport routes, but that it must complement, rather than dominate, the morphological representation. A moderate color weight improves the purity of the target cluster, whereas over-prioritizing color degrades the structural understanding of the vehicles and leads either to over-segmentation or to the collapse of the clustering space.
blocks.zh: 总的来说,这些结果证实,颜色是确定公共交通路线的一个极具歧视性的提示,但必须补充而不是支配形态代表性。 适度的色彩重量可以提高目标集群的纯度,而过于优先的色彩则会降低对飞行器的结构理解,导致过度的分隔或集群空间的崩溃.

blocks.en: V Conclusions
blocks.zh: 五 结论

blocks.en: This study presented an unsupervised pipeline for clustering public transport vehicles captured by a surveillance camera, in which frozen DINOv2 morphological features and HSV color histograms are combined through weighted early fusion and grouped with UMAP and K-Means. Without using any labels during feature extraction or clustering, the best configuration isolated RTP buses in a cluster with higher precision and F1-score than morphological features alone. These results confirm that color provides information that self-supervised features alone do not capture well, since it separates buses that share a body structure but belong to different routes.
blocks.zh: 这项研究提供了一条无监督的管道,用于集聚被监视摄像头捕获的公共交通车辆,其中冷冻的DINOv2形态特征和HSV彩色直方图通过加权早期聚变组合,并与UMAP和K-Means组合在一起. 在特征提取或集群过程中不使用任何标签,最佳配置将RTP总线隔离在一个集群中,其精度和F1分数都高于形态特征. 这些结果证实,色彩提供了仅靠自我监督的特征并不能很好地捕捉的信息,因为它将共享身体结构但属于不同路线的巴士分开.

blocks.en: The ablation study also showed that the fusion weight is critical. A balanced weight fragmented the target class into many small clusters, whereas a color-dominant weight collapsed the space into three clusters that mixed vans, microbuses, and full-size buses. Color should therefore complement, not replace, the morphological representation.
blocks.zh: 消化研究还表明,聚变重量至关重要. 平衡的重量将目标类别分割成许多小集群,而色彩占上风的重量则将空间分解为三个集群,将面包车、微客车和全尺寸公共汽车混合在一起。 因此,颜色应该补充而不是取代形态表现。

blocks.en: The approach has limitations. Some RTP buses were still assigned to secondary clusters and the number of clusters was selected with internal criteria that do not guarantee semantic correspondence. Future work will explore late fusion based on descriptor-specific distances combined with density-based algorithms such as HDBSCAN, which do not require the number of clusters to be fixed in advance. Evaluation on multiple cameras and routes will also be necessary to assess the generality of the method.
blocks.zh: 这种办法有局限性。 一些RTP巴士仍然被分配到二级集群,集群的数量被选用内部标准而不保证语义通信. 未来工作将探索基于描述器特定距离的延迟聚变,结合HDBSCAN等基于密度的算法,这些算法不需要提前固定集群的数量. 还需要对多个摄像机和路线进行评价,以评估该方法的普遍性。
